topic: Day 36 — carousel — Intimacy is being known and still chosen, not just being close

slides.text: Intimacy is being known, and [chosen] anyway.
Sharing a bed isn't the same as being truly seen.
Closeness can coexist with real emotional distance.
Real intimacy requires the riskier act of being visible.

caption:
Sharing a bed or a life with someone isn't the same as being deeply, accurately seen by them and still wanted anyway.

Follow for one of these a day.
